mapper.select: SELECT id FROM prd_document WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: p.id, p.title, p.status, p.revision, p.current_version_id, (SELECT v.version_no FROM prd_version v WHERE v.id = p.current_version_id) AS current_version_no, p.current_score, (SELECT count(*) FROM review_job r WHERE r.prd_id = p.id) AS review_count, p.owner_id, u.display_name AS owner_name, p.updated_at
(p.owner_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prd_member m WHERE m.prd_id = p.id AND m.user_id = #{userId}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prd_document (id, title, status, owner_id, draft_json, draft_markdown, revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{status}, #{ownerId}, #{draftJson}::jsonb, #{draftMarkdown}, #{revision}, now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.status, p.owner_id, p.draft_json::text AS draft_json, p.draft_markdown, p.revision, p.current_version_id, p.current_score, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (SELECT v.version_no FROM prd_version v WHERE v.id = p.current_version_id) AS current_version_no, u.display_name AS owner_name FROM prd_document p JOIN app_user u ON u.id = p.owner_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE prd_document SET draft_json = #{draftJson}::jsonb, draft_markdown = #{draftMarkdown}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision}
UPDATE prd_document SET current_version_id = #{versionId}, current_score = NULL, status = CASE WHEN status = 'ARCHIVED' THEN status ELSE 'DRAFT' END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE prd_document SET status = #{status}, current_score = #{currentScore}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND current_version_id = #{versionId} AND status != 'ARCHIVED'
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN p.owner_id = #{userId} THEN 'OWNER' ELSE (SELECT m.role FROM prd_member m WHERE m.prd_id = p.id AND m.user_id = #{userId}) END AS role FROM prd_document p WHERE p.id = #{prdId}
